title: Will Doing Life be Top US Netflix Movie on Oct 12, 2026?
rules: If Doing Life is #1 on the Netflix Top 10 US Movie on the chart published on Oct 13, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The Netflix charts are updated on Tuesday. Therefore, the market will close at 11:59 PM ET the day before. The chart published on Oct 13, 2026 will be for the week ending the previous Sunday.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Netflix. Any references to Netflix, or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Netflix and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Doing Life debuted Oct 2 at only #3 globally with 9.3M views, far behind Unabomber's 24.9M, and coverage called it a disappointment. Unabomber appears to have led the US chart last week. Ben Affleck's big-budget thriller Animals premieres Oct 9, inside the Oct 5–11 chart week, and is the clear favorite for US #1. Doing Life would have to beat both films in its second weekend, which is very unlikely.
blind.falsifier: The Oct 13 Netflix US Top 10 movie chart lists Doing Life at #1, ahead of Animals and Unabomber.

final.reasoning: The 41% price suggests traders see US-specific strength I can't verify, possibly from daily charts, so I raised my estimate from 2% to 18%. Ben Affleck's Animals premieres October 9 inside the chart week and remains the likely US #1. The market still looks too high on YES.
